items.hed: The Rockets ran away from Denver 110-100 at Toyota Center, improving to 8-3 as Kevin Durant and Alperen Sengun led the way
items.insight: Houston led by double digits for most of the night and held off a late Nuggets push, with Durant scoring 23 points and Sengun adding 20 as the Rockets snapped a two-game skid and moved to 8-3. Denver, playing without several starters who were on the injury report, fell to 5-4; Jamal Murray led the Nuggets with 38 points.

items.hed: New GM Randy Flores opens his first GM Meetings today with a manager's chair still empty and a possible Dec. 1 lockout on the calendar
items.insight: The GM Meetings begin today, and the Houston Chronicle reports Flores, who officially took over as general manager Oct. 30 and was introduced publicly Nov. 2 at Daikin Park, arrives needing to fill the manager's job left open since Joe Espada's departure while weighing roster questions ahead of baseball's Dec. 1 work-stoppage deadline. As of this morning, the Astros had not announced a new manager.

items.hed: Head coach DeMeco Ryans and quarterback C.J. Stroud credited Tank Dell's 100-yard, one-touchdown return game for sparking Sunday's 44-22 rout of the Chargers
items.insight: The Texans' official site reports Ryans and Stroud singled out Dell's performance, his second game back, as a lift for the offense in the win that improved Houston to 3-5. Ryans also praised a physical defensive effort, including Jalen Pitre's energy and a long-awaited interception from Derek Stingley Jr. The Texans next travel to face the Browns at Huntington Bank Field on Sunday, Nov. 15.
